customer_name: Ningbo Yinzhou District (宁波市鄞州区)
business_problem: Yinzhou District needed a more efficient way to supervise a very large and frequently changing population of storefront businesses because manual safety oversight could not keep up with the breadth of local commercial activity.
solution_summary: Yinzhou District and partner Lancheng IoT built the "Ma Shang Anquan" supervision platform on Baidu AI Cloud to digitize storefront safety management across merchants, grid inspectors, and street safety offices. Tiangong IoT Platform provides the edge-cloud backbone, while the IoT Safety Suite and the Ma Shang Anquan application expose QR-code access, safety scorecards, and inspection workflows. Each shop gets one code and one archive compatible with the enterprise safety code, and merchants or inspectors can log in from WeChat, DingTalk, or Alipay to complete self-checks, patrol checks, and photo uploads. The platform automatically selects checklists by shop type across more than 10 safety items, then ranks stores, highlights red-list and black-list cases, and gives regulators data to adjust inspection frequency. The result is an IoT-enabled governance loop that centralizes field evidence and turns local safety oversight into a scalable, data-driven process.
products_used: Ma Shang Anquan Smart Supervision Platform

solution_components.name: IoT Safety Suite
solution_components.role: Supplies the safety-inspection toolkit and QR-based supervision functions used by the deployment.

solution_components.name: Tiangong IoT Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the edge-cloud IoT foundation that coordinates the inspection workflows and three-party linkage model.

solution_components.name: Ma Shang Anquan Smart Supervision Platform
solution_components.role: Lets merchants, grid inspectors, and safety officials scan codes, submit checks and photos, and review rankings and safety status.

data_flow: Merchants and inspectors scan each store's QR code from WeChat, DingTalk, or Alipay, then submit checklist answers and photo evidence into the Ma Shang Anquan platform running on Tiangong IoT. The platform assigns checklists by business type, updates each store's electronic safety archive and score, and surfaces rankings and risk signals so street safety offices can target follow-up inspections.
business_outcome: The platform created recognized three-party coordination across merchants, community grid leaders, and street safety offices, helped the pilot street keep safety accidents and fire casualties at zero, and gave Ningbo a model for scaling digital safety supervision citywide.
metrics: 10+ safety and fire-safety inspection items are covered.
The planned citywide rollout targets 800,000 street-front merchants.
During the Minglou Street pilot, safety accidents and fire casualties both stayed at zero.
architecture_clues: Each shop receives an electronic safety score archive with one code per store.
The platform is compatible with the enterprise safety code and supports WeChat, DingTalk, and Alipay access.
Checklist content is customized automatically by shop type.
Regulators can view rankings, top-ten red-list stores, black-list stores, and inspection history from the backend.
evidence_quotes: "Ma Shang Anquan" achieved three-way linkage among enterprises, community grid leaders, and street safety offices on top of the Tiangong platform (original: 依托天工平台，“码上安全”实现了企业经营主体、社区网格长、街道安监所三方联动).
The district faced a contradiction between a huge, widely distributed set of businesses and too few safety-regulation staff (original: 生产经营单位“量大面广”与安全监管力量“人少事繁”的矛盾日渐突出).
Every store gets one code and can log in from mainstream apps such as WeChat, DingTalk, and Alipay to upload self-checks and photos (original: 每家店铺都有一个专属电子安全积分档案，实现一户一码，与企业安全码兼容，支持微信、钉钉、支付宝等主流APP).
The platform can automatically choose inspection lists by store type and covers more than 10 safety and fire-safety items (original: 可根据企业商铺类型自动选择检查清单，涵盖安全生产、消防安全等10余个项目).

The Minglou Street pilot kept safety accidents and fire casualties at zero, and Ningbo planned to extend the platform to 800,000 street-front shops (original: 该街道安全事故、亡人数为零、消防事故伤亡人数均保持零发生…实现80万沿街商铺的全覆盖).
